text: The historical FolderDatabase::Startup rejects its promise holder when getting the folder cache or servers fails, but the added code continues past those branches instead of returning. This is a conditional static concern in the 2024 background loader, not a reproduced failure or current implementation claim. Current synchronous startup returns on EnsureConnection failure. Proposed review check for this old pattern: inspect both promise settlement and the remaining work after rejection. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: A rejected startup Promise still needs control-flow termination
